duplicatedFrom.why: The owner: "duplicate InThisTown and rename that duplicated one Stories then work there". This topic starts as an exact copy of the In This Town pack, numbers included, and diverges from here. In This Town stays as it was.

premise.oneLiner: One film, one story, any world. A first-person Minecraft story with an impossible fact in the first second, a rule the viewer can follow, and a last line that turns the first one over.
premise.flexible: There is no fixed town and no required opening. The setting is invented per film: the pack in this folder is a box of parts, not a canon. What is fixed is the shape (see README.md) and the numbers in `film`.
mustHave: an impossible or strange fact said in the first three words, proved by a picture
a rule of this world, stated plainly, that the viewer can play along with
escalation with no repeated beat, a low point, a turn that re-reads an earlier line
a payoff you can see, then the ask, last, inside the story
never: a second film of a shape another film already used
a premise that needs the old town to make sense
voice only: music, air and effects are mandatory

reference.owner: yes its good put it as the topic's reference
reference.use: The old topic's approved film, inherited with the copy. Build the SHAPE like it — 14 beats, the same pace, the same sound discipline — and never retell its story or reuse its town.

origin.what: The Roblox video the format was taken from. The numbers in `film` come from measuring it. Studied, never copied.

lastLineAlsoAccepted.why: The owner, 2026-11-12, on his own outline for this film: a one-shot with no part two or three, so it must not end with 'like and sub for part two'. His words: 'make it Like the video if you.. hmm something that motivates people who also have expreince with that'. The exception is named here, for this film only.

film.shortsRule: A vertical video over 3:00 is not a YouTube Short: YouTube files it as a long video. Two films were delivered at 3:41 and 3:25 and had to be cut down after the owner saw that (2026-11-13). No film of this topic runs over 2:58, and there is no longer cut.

middle.note: For in-this-town-monster-village-part-2: the owner's own outline, approved as a script, runs two minutes, between the short cut and the long one.

models.note: Finished films the owner approved, to build like. The first is the topic's reference film. Each is kept with its source and its mp4 in Topics/Stories/Old Reference (README.md there lists them). Copy how they are built; never copy their story.

models.in-this-town-monster-egg: The long cut (18 beats, 93 shots). Voice only: it was made before the sound rule. The owner: 'every single one u made is good'. Page, source and mp4: Topics/Stories/Old Reference/monster-egg.
models.in-this-town-superpower-at-18: The long cut with sound (90 shots), from the owner's own outline. The owner: 'wow i love it, i love how u made the short'. Page, source and mp4: Topics/Stories/Old Reference/superpower-at-18.
models.in-this-town-monster-village: The long cut (74 shots, 2:55; trimmed from 3:41 to be a Short), monsters as a family, night. The owner: 'i liked the superhero and this one'. Page, source and mp4: Topics/Stories/Old Reference/monster-village.
models.in-this-town-monster-village-part-2: The middle cut (54 shots): a sequel on part one's world, from the owner's own outline. The owner: 'perfect'. Page, source and mp4: Topics/Stories/Old Reference/monster-village-part-2.
models.in-this-town-superpower-at-18-part-2: Fast action and flying (83 shots). The owner: 'a banger and a massive upgrade'. Page, source and mp4: Topics/Stories/Old Reference/superpower-at-18-part-2.

Long cut (86 shots, 2:54; trimmed from 3:25 to be a Short): a sword fight on the ground and in the air, built from posed bodies, hit-freezes and cuts inside a line (scene6.tsx, fight.tsx). models.in-this-town-pumpkin-heads: A second short cut with sound (58 shots), and an ending that is a picture. The owner approved the script and asked for that ending. Page, source and mp4: Topics/Stories/Old Reference/pumpkin-heads.
models.in-this-town-every-kid-got-an-iron-golem: PACE, and a premise that states its reason. Middle cut (61 shots, 2:13). 234 words a minute with a quarter to three quarters of a second of silence between story steps: the owner rejected 249 with no air and then 220 with up to a second. The rule's reason is told in five full sentences, one shot each. The owner: 'pretty nice', 'this is a good short'. Page, source and mp4: Topics/Stories/Old Reference/iron-golem.
models.in-this-town-we-are-all-cats: A whole story in one film, and a funny one (short cut, 42 shots, 1:23), from the owner's own outline; no part two, at his request. The cat and dog players, villagers and golems built for it are in the pack (Topics/Stories/catsdogs.tsx). The owner: 'this is actually really funny, i love this'. Page, source and mp4: Topics/Stories/Old Reference/we-are-all-cats.
models.in-this-town-everyone-runs-away-from-me: THE MONSTER VILLAGE RECIPE, SHORT. One cat in a town of creepers: a famous mob as family, the teller the odd one out, players as the danger, and Minecraft facts as the jokes (short cut, 50 shots, 1:40). A whole story in one film. The creeper family, crowd, houses and gunpowder players built for it are in the pack (Topics/Stories/creepertown.tsx). The owner: 'really cute short, i like it'. Page, source and mp4: Topics/Stories/Old Reference/everyone-runs-away-from-me.
models.in-this-town-i-have-never-seen-my-mums-f: A SCRIPT HE APPROVED BEFORE THE BUILD, and a reveal held for the last twenty seconds (short cut, 52 shots, 1:46). A kid raised by endermen has never seen his mum's face, because looking makes her scream; a carved pumpkin is the answer. A whole story in one film. The enderman family, crowd, houses, pumpkin players, kitchen and rain built for it are in the pack (Topics/Stories/endertown.tsx). The owner: 'another banger idea' (the script), then 'i like it but it was kinda similar to the creeper one ... it might get me in trouble of reused content'. So: copy how it is built, and do NOT make a third film of this shape (one odd kid in a town of one famous mob, players at night). Page, source and mp4: Topics/Stories/Old Reference/never-seen-my-mums-face.

music.owner: the music is used thats the new backround music for the in this town shorts
music.note: The owner's own track is the background music of every In This Town short from this date. A film's sound.json names it in `music.track`; `scripts/sound.py build` refuses a sheet that does not, or one where it plays under less than `minShare` of the film (a `none` section is silence); `draft` writes it in. `gain` is the level to start from: -16, the level of Superpower part 2, the first film that played it.
music.madeBeforeNote: Finished before the owner chose the track. An approved film does not change: these keep the music they were approved with, which scripts/sound.py makes from moods.

sound.minMusicSectionsNote: Counts only for a film whose music is made from moods (the films in music.madeBefore). A film that plays the owner's track has one piece of music.

measuredFromOrigin.note: The treehouse video has music under every second of it. Its quietest 8% of 20 ms frames (the gaps between words, where only music is left) are 20.7 dB under its loudest 40% (speech). The same measure on in-this-town-same-face reads 22: our music is a little further back.

measuredFromReference.note: The mix of the reference film, as scripts/sound.py measured it (src/videos/in-this-town-same-face/sound.lock.json).
